description: Selected character record is read at index who; the other seven records hold distinct decoys in every field the function reads. 0x52b1c0 and 0x52af50 (D4 formula nodes) are address-stubbed: argument values and call counts are outputs; the caller ignores their return values. 0x547940 and 0x5479b0 and the 0x5e1c22 float truncation run natively. Fraction and rate fields are binary32 bit patterns; the case keeps them finite and below the int64 range because the original truncation helper faults outside it.
